svg.title: Phase 4 coupon initialization
svg.desc: The reset script resets MySQL and Redis data, calls the initialization API, and the API copies coupon quantity and dates from MySQL to Redis.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Noto Sans KR', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: reset-coupon.sh는 기존 실험을 정리한 뒤, DB 쿠폰 값을 Redis에 올립니다.
